prompt: Challenge C145-CH1: Our adtech platform inserts pre-roll ads into podcast episodes, but the targeting is purely demographic; click-through rates are stuck at 0.

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Semantic embedding methods for short audio descriptions can distinguish content similarity with higher accuracy than surface lexical features, using transformer-based approaches fine-tuned on domain-specific corpora.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-09847","field":"abstract","quote":"sentence-level embeddings produced by a fine-tuned multilingual BERT variant"}]},{"text":"Contrastive learning objectives trained on implicit user engagement signals produce audio embeddings that outperform text-only baselines on retrieval and content matching tasks.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-09851","field":"abstract","quote":"contrastive model achieves NDCG@10 = 0.74, exceeding a supervised sentence-transformer baseline"}]},{"text":"Multilingual audio metadata classification systems can be developed and deployed within industry constraints, with practical experience managing annotation workflows and building recommendation prototypes that enter operational use.","sources":[{"id":"R0931","field":"industry_experience","quote":"developed prototip sistema za preporučivanje koji je ušao u internu upotrebu"}]}],"fit":"strong","fitReason":"The researcher has demonstrated expertise in semantic embedding of audio descriptions [SYN-PUB-09847], contrastive learning for content matching [SYN-PUB-09851], and deployed recommendation systems in production [R0931], directly addressing SoundSlot's need to build content-context matching for ad targeting."}
